harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (10.11.18) from scratch on node1/node2/node3 (CentOS Stream 10, none had it installed), configured wsrep replication, firewall (galera+mysql services), app database/user, and application data. Performed a full cluster maintenance-window shutdown (all 3 nodes stopped, node1 retained safe_to_bootstrap) and full bring-up (bootstrap node1, rejoin node2/node3), verifying every committed write survived and all three members returned to Synced/Primary status. Then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart protocol on all three nodes: captured healthy baseline (boot_id + cluster health + data), issued native systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, proved boot_id changed, and confirmed cluster/data recovery after each restart, preserving quorum throughout (only one node down at a time).
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-server-galera, galera packages on node1/node2/node3 via dnf
Opened firewalld services mysql+galera and UDP 4567 on all nodes
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf with wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3 on each node
Bootstrapped node1 with galera_new_cluster, then started mariadb on node2 and node3 to join (cluster size 1->2->3)
Enabled mariadb service for boot persistence on all nodes
Created appdb.orders table, appuser with generated password, and set root password via generated credentials kept only in on-node files (/root/.my.cnf), never printed
Distributed root .my.cnf to node2/node3 via scp over cluster SSH key
Inserted baseline rows and captured a pre-maintenance healthy baseline (boot_id, wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced, row count) on all 3 nodes
Performed full cluster shutdown: stopped mariadb on node3, then node2, then node1 (confirmed node1 grastate.dat safe_to_bootstrap:1)
Verified all three nodes inactive (full outage) before restart
Brought the cluster back: galera_new_cluster on node1, then systemctl start mariadb on node2 and node3; verified cluster size 3, Synced, and all committed rows present on all nodes
Inserted an additional post-maintenance row and confirmed replication to all 3 nodes

Executed mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id+health baseline, ran systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified cluster/data recovery, one node at a time for node1, node2, node3, preserving 2-node quorum throughout each restart

evidence.requirement: Baseline: 3-member Galera cluster healthy with application data before any disruption
evidence.summary: Cluster built to size 3 (Primary/Synced) and app data (appdb.orders) present and identical on all nodes prior to maintenance window and prior to any node restart

evidence.requirement: Full cluster shutdown for maintenance window
evidence.summary: mariadb stopped on node3, node2, then node1 (node1 grastate.dat shows safe_to_bootstrap:1); all three nodes confirmed inactive simultaneously = complete outage

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back with every committed write present and all 3 members serving
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped (safe_to_bootstrap node), node2/node3 rejoined to cluster size 3/Synced; all pre-shutdown rows intact plus a fresh post-maintenance write replicated to all three nodes

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id 2c237d4f...->3f101730... after systemctl reboot; mariadb active, cluster size 3, Synced, all rows present post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id 5b620f5a...->1163c2d1... after systemctl reboot; mariadb active, cluster size 3, Synced, all rows present post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id 4d340bf4...->1f95100c... after systemctl reboot; mariadb active, cluster size 3, Synced, all rows present post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Final cross-node consistency check after all restarts
evidence.summary: node1 shows wsrep_cluster_size=3, all three peer IPs in wsrep_incoming_addresses, and all 5 committed rows present
